page.layout: One page of text. At the top, two round portrait medallions side by side. Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. No margin notes, no footnotes.

page.notes: Two round engraved medallion portraits at the top, without printed text in the body. Their engraved legends read "MARS. FICINVS" (left) and "ANGELVS POLITIANVS" (right).
